action_inputs.description: SVR- ids to delete, separated by commas or spaces; only servers in Provision Failed state. Empty lists the failed servers.
action_inputs.label: Servers to delete (SVR- ids)
action_inputs.name: onb_delete_servers

label: POC Onboarding: Failed Servers
mcp_tool_description: List the servers left in Provision Failed state by orders that failed (fetch_server_list shows only active servers, so they are invisible otherwise), or delete the ones named in onb_delete_servers. Each listed server has its hostname, environment, group, owner, created date, provision job, order and inCloud (true when a VM was created, so the delete also removes it from the cloud). Call it after a failed order once the cause is known, and before the wrap-up. Show the user the servers and get explicit agreement before deleting: the delete cannot be undone. A delete runs CloudBolt's own decommission and returns a delete job to poll with fetch_job, or an order when fast-track decommission is off. Only Provision Failed servers are accepted. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
